# Copilot instructions

This is a website exported from Hlou. Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repository root and follow it: write pages, content and theme in the spec
(`hlou/site/**`) and check them with `pnpm hlou:compile`; never edit `site/**`,
`hlou/site.lock.json`, `package.json` or `next.config.*`; put new code in
`custom/**` and `app/(custom)/**`; change a block's markup only through a
`codeVariant` branch; people, domains and publishing stay in Hlou.
Topic notes: `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`.
